reconstructed_captions.5: A C-130 military transport plane begins its takeoff roll on the desert floor.
reconstructed_captions.6: The plane accelerates rapidly, its propellers blurring against the desert background.
reconstructed_captions.7: As the C-130 gains speed, it begins to kick up a significant cloud of dust.
reconstructed_captions.8: The plane lifts off the ground, becoming airborne over the desert.
reconstructed_captions.9: The C-130 climbs away from the camera, leaving a trail of dust behind it.
reconstructed_captions.10: The plane continues to fly away as the dust cloud on the ground begins to expand.
